title: JC H2 differentiation: connected rates of change
subject: math

choices.text: The rate of change of y with respect to x, as a single limit symbol.
A fraction d times y divided by d times x, so the d symbols cancel.
choices.misconception: Cancelling the d symbols in dy/dx.

rationale.chose: The learner selected option A fraction d times y divided by d times x, so the d symbols cancel. as their answer to this question.
rationale.thinks: They are applying the coded wrong turn instead of checking what each part of the working represents.
rationale.reteach: Reteach by writing dy/dx as the limit of delta y over delta x, stressing it is one symbol for a rate, not a fraction to cancel.
